content:
Thanks to @Tanner Duve we now can write imperative style algorithms (and circuits and Turing machines) in the Prog implementation of the query combinator model. An example with bubble sort exists in Algolean. We can use mvcgen to prove an algorithm’s correctness.

CC: @Fabrizio Montesi perhaps CSLib would like this?
We can also demo some Turing machine examples later this week if you like.

perhaps CSLib would like this?

I think https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/604 is adding the same to cslib
yes, minus the bubble sort example since it’s specific to algolean
when this gets merged to cslib, algolean will just use cslib’s version
